text: I suggest you visit the disability desk at his BL branch and ask about it. I have not applied but I spoke to a clerk that was very encouraging. He will need to provide as extensive medical records as possible to support his case. Even if he has chronic issues that are undiagnosed, even the proof of ongoing tests and complaints to specialists are taken into consideration. So if he doesnt have much medical record in Israel, he needs to start building one. And if i understand correctly, being rejected should not hurt later attempts to apply again.
